The '''DF .9 Mobile Emplacement Gun''' was manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. Four of these weapons were attached to the gun battery assigned to the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]] command unit.
